distinct_hypothesis: Typed aggregate array fields and fixed-base indexing might prevent folding every unrolled access into the common byte base. Both experiments compile identically to baseline, disproving this under the existing flags. No repeated all-pointers-live experiment or compiler policy change.

measurements.name: baseline
measurements.hypothesis: Accepted base; identical source to fbd0b93d and the integrated eaa91e9d candidate.

measurements.name: experiment-indexed
measurements.hypothesis: Replace scalar pointer increments with fixed-base array indexing.

measurements.name: experiment-aggregate
measurements.hypothesis: Declare a typed global aggregate with correctly sized array/record fields instead of byte-offset casts; use indexed scalar accesses.

measurements.name: experiment-tail-order
measurements.hypothesis: Retain the baseline and order final record stores as r16a[3], r16b[3], r24a.d, r24b.d, r8.b to match retail.

measurements.name: experiment-early-global
measurements.hypothesis: On top of tail-order, initialize lbl_8064D634 before the first array loop to test scheduling.

measurements.name: experiment-register-hint
measurements.hypothesis: On top of tail-order, apply standard C register hints to array and record pointers.

retained: experiment-tail-order; standard C, one NonMatching translation unit; comment updated only after measurement.

experiment_steps: Start from the stated base commit in an isolated worktree.
Apply the corresponding standard unified patch with patch -p0 from the repository root.
From eternal-darkness-decomp run python3 configure.py, then .tools/bin/ninja -j2 build/GEDE01/src/game/game_fn_801ED118.o.
Run the canonical objdiff command with the corresponding experiment output filename. Patches are independent against the base, not cumulative.

behavior_review: All final executable changes reorder four independent aligned word writes to distinct record arrays. Record sizes remain 16/24/8 bytes, loop count remains 16, and all addresses, constants, flags and pointer increments are unchanged. No assembly, calls, volatile accesses, output patching, toolchain changes or neighbor changes.
dol_scope: NonMatching registration remains unchanged, so the verified DOL retains retail bytes for this function. Whole-DOL hash success does not establish a C match.
